subject: LISTING directive
notes: { ON | OFF } with ON un-underlined (rendered from the printed page, folio 78), so a bare >>LISTING selects it - which is what 7.3.18.3 GR4/GR5 call 'specifying or implying the ON phrase'. Any other operand is COBOL1911. The directive itself is a no-op under 7.3.18.3 GR1: this compiler produces no source listing.
